scope.notes: Crosses panel/setup/callback, chat parsing and replies, OBS product copy, persisted settings, host tools, community catalogs, docs, and CI; more than 20 files likely.

integration.notes: Coordinates browser ESM, Node ESM, PostgreSQL, Compose and native shell/PowerShell entry points; no remote translation provider is needed.

infrastructure.notes: Requires persisted locale behavior, settings compatibility, catalog packaging/serving, and install/update/uninstall coordination.

knowledge.notes: Requires locale/Intl, chat grammar and role stability, secure localization boundaries, Windows/macOS/Linux script behavior, and contribution workflow.

risk.notes: Locale drift, accidental legacy command aliases, backend error leakage, XSS/shell injection, and locale mismatch while API/database is unavailable need explicit coverage.

flags: The independent spec v3 re-review returned CONCERNS without a new score; the three editorial findings were corrected, and implementation QA remains pending.
The PostgreSQL/host locale projection architecture is selected; crash, write failure, corruption, stale/offline behavior, and recovery still require tests.
The UTF-8 TSV contract is selected; parser, encoding, safe placeholders/plurals, and cross-platform parity still require tests.
Global roots fila, queue, and cola are reserved; existing collisions block only the conflicting root until an explicit rename, per owner decision.
Streamer-authored text preservation and tool names (setup/update/uninstall) were approved by the owner; dependent behaviors still require tests.
TDD and real PostgreSQL migrations are required for locale persistence and migration behavior.
FND-8 is intended to be the first beta MINOR v1.1.0, but stage promotion/release remains unauthorized.
